Santa Barbara County Employees’ Retirement System (SBCERS)", "node_id": "0003", "start_index": 3, "end_index": 4, "summary": "Established in 1944, SBCERS has about $3.1 billion in assets and provides retirement, disability, death, and survivor benefits under California’s County Employees’ Retirement Law. Members include permanent County and court employees and employees of nine contracting districts: four cemetery districts (Carpinteria, Goleta, Oak Hill, Santa Maria), Carpinteria-Summerland Fire Protection, County Mosquito & Vector Management, County Air Pollution Control, Santa Barbara County Association of Governments, and Summerland Sanitary. The nine-member, two-alternate Retirement Board sets plan policy and oversees investments; four members are appointed by the Supervisors, six elected by members (general, safety, and retirees), and the County Treasurer serves ex officio.
